caption: The video captures a quiet interior still-life that appears unchanged across the sequence. In the right foreground, a glossy yellow-orange mug with its handle pointing left rests on a reddish-pink saucer atop a bright white, reflective tabletop. Behind the cup, a dark sofa spans the frame, draped with a red pillow at each end and an open book lying on the seat. A string of small warm, candle-like bulbs is scattered across the sofa's back and cushions, their glow mirrored as bright reflections on the polished surface below. A pale-shaded floor lamp stands at the left, while a framed abstract painting hangs on the light-blue wall above the sofa's center. The arrangement and the tabletop reflections look the same from the first view to the last, giving the scene a steady, tableau-like quality.
